player_0.content: New plan: I prematurely concluded the exploration by issuing "DONE" while in the Laundry room, failing to check if all reachable directions from the current node and previously visited nodes had been fully explored. Specifically, upon returning to the Guest room (which had available directions: north, south, east), I only took the north path back to the Laundry room and stopped, ignoring the unexplored "east" direction from the Guest room. My new strategy is to maintain a strict list of unvisited directions for every room I have entered. Before issuing "DONE", I must verify that every room in my `nodes` list has had all its available directions traversed. If I return to a room with untried directions (like the "east" from Guest room), I must prioritize exploring those before considering the task complete. I will only stop when I am in a room with no untried directions and my graph confirms all connected nodes have been visited.
